warnings: PNG contains two portrait sheets rotated 90 degrees within one landscape scan; programmatically cropped to left/right halves and rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. This file is the physical RIGHT half (the lower-numbered sheet, แผ่นที่ 3/21), paired with แผ่นที่ 4/21 (หมวดงานสถาปัตยกรรม rollup, LEFT half) extracted as _2.json.

This sheet closes out หมวดงานโครงสร้าง (item 1), continuing directly from บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_07_หน้า78_2_structural_boq.json (แผ่นที่ 2/21, items 1.1-1.9) -- the two files together form the complete หมวดงานโครงสร้าง item list, ending with 'รวมข้อ 1 หมวดงานโครงสร้าง'.

The 2 steel-channel rows use a bracket-like rolled-channel symbol ('[') before the dimension string, small at this resolution -- dimensions themselves (150x50x20x3.2, 100x50x20x3.2 mm) and quantities (284, 704 kg) are clearly legible and high-confidence; only the leading symbol glyph is flagged, same convention as house #5's equivalent sheet.
All unit-price/amount columns are blank in the source for every row on this sheet, including the 'รวมข้อ 1' grand-total row -- transcribed as null, not invented.
All quantities re-verified at 3x zoom after rotating a programmatic crop of the right half (108, 108, 284, 704, 11, 85).
